title: Clinical Effects of Soluble Dietary Fiber Supplementation
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of pectin, a kind of soluble dietary fiber, on colonic transit time, clinical symptoms and the gut microbiota in adults with slow-transit constipation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients(age≧18y)
* Admitted for slow-transit constipation were considered eligible

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mental disorders
* Cancer
* Inflammatory bowel disease
